claims.claim: For the quarter ended June 30, 2026, revenue was $90.0 billion.
Revenue increased 18% compared to the prior year period.
On a constant currency basis, revenue increased 17%.
Operating income for the quarter was $40.6 billion.
Operating income increased 18% year-over-year.
Net income was $35.8 billion on a GAAP basis, up 31%.
Net income was $35.3 billion on a non-GAAP basis, up 22%.
Non-GAAP results exclude the impact from investments in OpenAI.
Diluted earnings per share were $4.81 on a GAAP basis, an increase of 32%.
Diluted earnings per share were $4.74 on a non-GAAP basis, an increase of 23%.
Microsoft Cloud revenue reached $59.3 billion, increasing 27% year-over-year.
Azure and other cloud services revenue grew by 43%.
Commercial remaining performance obligation increased 84% to $678 billion.
Productivity and Business Processes revenue was $37.8 billion, up 14%.
Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 14% on a reported basis.
Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue rose 24%.
LinkedIn revenue increased 12%.
Dynamics 365 revenue grew 13%.
Intelligent Cloud revenue was $39.3 billion, up 32%.
More Personal Computing revenue decreased 4% to $12.9 billion.
XBOX content and services revenue declined 10%.
Windows OEM and Devices revenue dropped 7%.
The More Personal Computing revenue decline was driven by the XBOX and Windows OEM and Devices declines.
Search advertising revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs increased 10%.
The release states that Microsoft will provide forward-looking guidance in connection with this quarterly earnings announcement on its earnings conference call and webcast.
No specific numerical guidance or outlook figures are provided within the text of this earnings release.
Microsoft returned $10.2 billion to shareholders in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 through dividends and share repurchases.
As of June 30, 2026, total cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments were $76.8 billion.
As of June 30, 2026, total stockholders' equity stood at $442.4 billion.
Additions to property and equipment for the quarter were $35.8 billion.
The release notes that discrete items resulted in a benefit of $0.27 on diluted earnings per share.
The discrete items included a $3.2 billion gain from the investment in Anthropic.
The 10% decrease in XBOX content and services revenue was partially offset by severance expense and impairment charges.
claims.note: Misreads the release. The 'partially offset by severance expense and impairment charges in XBOX' language refers to lower-than-expected Voluntary Retirement Program expenses among the discrete items measured against April 29, 2026 guidance, not to the XBOX revenue decline. Expenses cannot offset a revenue decline, and the release draws no such link.
